newsitem.title: USA: AOL users dispute "800" number fees - NYT.
newsitem.headline: AOL users dispute "800" number fees - NYT.

text.p: Hundreds of America Online subscribers are complaining about unexpected charges related to using an "800" dialing number to gain access to the service, the New York Times said on Friday.
The New York State Attorney General's office said it was looking into the complaints, the newspaper said.
America Online subscribers have been giving the number, which allows easier access to the service and bypasses busy signals, to each other, the paper said.
Had they obtained the number from the company, subscribers would have learned, after scrolling through several computer screens, the charge for using the "800" number was $6 per hour, the paper said.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
